allowed_claims: All five bounded corrections are persisted in the existing four-artifact task package and ready for Strategy Manager revalidation.
Eight feature definitions across five primitive families and all existing formulas/parameters/horizons remain unchanged; BAL14 v0.1 is R2_STATE_REGIME only.
The primary source class reuses the existing frozen Binance USD-M perpetual 1m completed-kline backbone.

The future source-only audit can precede the unresolved family-wise multiplicity gate only under a separate task with no outcome access.
No research execution, network acquisition, VPS raw data, protected P1 evidence, returns or PnL were accessed or calculated in this correction.
